about: Seat counts both the engine (c/shoreshElectiveEngine) and Assign's save check (ElectiveSeatTally) must give, one offering at one time (docs/protocol/elect.md ELECT-4.1, 4.4, 4.5). seats null is blank. Each camper wants the offering first; placed is how many Assign seats beside the locks.

cases.name: full: the rest are left out

countsAbout: Campers counted in one offering at the elective times of one day and block, as the Elective seats screen (c/shoreshElectiveSeats seats.js) and ElectiveSeatCounts (Assign's check, Finalize, Roots, an AI) must both count them (ELECT-4.1, 4.11). times: each time's bunks (a time is a division's). seated: each camper's bunk (null: no bunk, seated at the day and block's first time, as the screen shows them). count and over: per time.

counts.name: two divisions in one block are two times
over in one division, not the other
bunks of one time share its seats
a camper with no bunk sits at the first time
no limit ticked is never over
